nodes.label: Prediction Result Page Mockup (Danger)
nodes.description: UI mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) web app's prediction result screen showing the 'danger' outcome state. The top navigation bar shows the SEMD logo/tagline and icons for recent reports (รายงานล่าสุด), link reports (รายงานลิงก์), URL analysis (วิเคราะห์ URL), API access (เข้าถึง API), database access (เข้าถึงฐานข้อมูล), a GitHub link, and the logged-in user 'sample_user'. The main content is a result card displaying the analyzed URL (http://www.eab18fo.epizy.com), the analysis timestamp (2025/09/28 09:00), a prediction label 'เป็นอันตราย' (is dangerous/malicious) styled in red/pink to signal danger, a confidence percentage of 81.05%, a QR code, and a recommendations list advising the user to verify the source's authenticity and avoid clicking the link or downloading files from it. Below the card are two action buttons: 'หน้าหลัก' (Home) and 'แชร์ผลลัพธ์' (Share result).
